<thought>Using the base peak m/z 141.115364 as a protonated ion ([M+H]⁺), the neutral mass is ≈140.108 Da. The formula C₅H₁₆O₄ has a monoisotopic mass of 140.1049 Da, matching the observed mass within a few millidaltons, which is reasonable for this data.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H16O4</final_answer>
